text.title: Outcome Based Roadmaps Advanced Output Contract
text.summary: Pins the shape of a valid Outcome Based Roadmaps Advanced output. Subagent must satisfy this before returning to the caller.

required.field: true means decay applied unless cited

optional.field: metric + current + target + deadline, per r6-falsifiable-business-goal
outcome id → one-sentence link upward to the business goal, per r7-causal-hypothesis-per-outcome
outcome id → exactly one weekly-readable metric, per r8-leading-indicator-per-outcome
outcome_id + pre-registered success criteria, per r9-pre-registered-experiment-criteria
customer / board / engineering / sales views rendered from this tree, per r10-single-source-multi-audience

forbidden.pattern: any dependency edge with type empty
any Q+3 solution with confidence=high AND no cited evidence
any outcome with zero or more than one leading indicator
any experiment with empty outcome_id or success criteria added after the result
an audience view edited by hand rather than rendered from the source tree

allowed-transformations.transformation: Allowed to relax decay (Q+2 high) for solutions with cited multi-data-point evidence.
Allowed to merge two swim lanes mid-horizon with logged rationale (e.g. products sunset or merged).

example.note: Missing required keys — validator returns non-zero with violation list.

list.item: Every required field populated with a typed value
No forbidden pattern matches the output
